column2: The imposing castle on the hill made every visitor stop and stare.
column3: 山丘上氣勢宏偉的城堡讓每位訪客都停下來凝視。
column5: impose 強加 + ing：氣勢壓過來，讓人肅然

column2: The hotel charges a small incidental fee for towels, besides the room price.
column3: 除了房價，旅館還額外收取一筆毛巾的附帶小額費用。
column5: incident 事件 + al：順便跟著發生的小事

column2: The ticket price is all inclusive, so lunch and the museum visit are covered.
column3: 票價是全包的，所以午餐與博物館參觀都包含在內。
column5: in 在裡面 + clude 關 → 全關在範圍裡

column2: Her grandmother's advice proved invaluable when she started her first job.
column3: 她開始第一份工作時，祖母的建議被證明極為寶貴。
column5: in 不 + valuable 但意思是「貴到無法估價」

column2: Hungry and sleepy, the toddler became irritable and cried at everything.
column3: 又餓又睏的幼兒變得易怒，什麼都哭。
column5: irritate 惹惱 + able：一惹就生氣

column2: The joyous sound of children singing filled the school hall.
column3: 孩子們快樂的歌聲充滿了學校大廳。
column5: joy 快樂 + ous：充滿歡樂的

column2: Taiwan's legendary night markets are famous for fried chicken and bubble tea.
column3: 台灣傳奇的夜市以炸雞排和珍珠奶茶聞名。
column5: legend 傳說 + ary：像傳說一樣的

column2: The shop owner showed a legitimate license to prove the business was legal.
column3: 店主出示合法的執照，證明這門生意是合法的。
column5: leg 法律 (legal) + itimate：合乎法律的

column2: The meeting was lengthy, and by the end everyone was yawning.
column3: 會議冗長，到結束時每個人都在打呵欠。
column5: length 長度 + y：長得讓人想睡

column2: Don't take the idiom literally; "raining cats and dogs" has no real animals.
column3: 別照字面理解這句成語；「raining cats and dogs」並沒有真的動物。
column5: liter 字母 (letter)：照字母逐字讀

column2: By the age of seven, most children in the city are literate and can read stories.
column3: 城裡的大多數孩子到七歲就能讀寫，可以讀故事了。
column5: liter 字母 + ate：認得字母的

column2: After the rainy season, the hills turned lush and green.
column3: 雨季過後，山丘變得蒼翠茂盛。
column5: lush 像「啦許」：啦～許多綠葉長出來

column2: Knights in armor lived in stone castles in medieval Europe.
column3: 在中世紀的歐洲，穿盔甲的騎士住在石造城堡裡。
column5: medi 中間 + ev 年代 → 中間的時代

column2: The mellow peach was sweet and soft, ready to be eaten.
column3: 那顆熟透的桃子又甜又軟，可以吃了。
column5: mellow 像「妹囉」：妹妹一囉嗦，水果就熟透變軟

column2: The metropolitan area around Tokyo is home to millions of people.
column3: 東京周邊的大都會區住著數百萬人。
column5: metro 捷運：有捷運的大城市

column2: A militant group demanded quick change and refused to wait any longer.
column3: 一個激進團體要求盡快改變，並拒絕再等下去。
column5: milit 軍隊 (military)：像軍隊般積極進攻

column2: He builds miniature ships and puts them inside glass bottles.
column3: 他製作迷你小船，並把它們放進玻璃瓶裡。
column5: mini 小：迷你加 ature，整個小小的

column2: The tiny baby's miraculous recovery surprised even the experienced doctors.
column3: 那個小嬰兒神奇的康復連經驗豐富的醫生都感到驚訝。
column4: a miraculous recovery (奇蹟般的康復)
column5: miracle 奇蹟 + ous：像奇蹟的

column2: The mischievous kitten hid my socks and then watched me look for them.
column3: 那隻調皮的小貓把我的襪子藏起來，然後看著我到處找。
column5: mischief 惡作劇 + ous：愛搗蛋的

column2: A missionary school was built in the village by a church group long ago.
column3: 很久以前，一個教會團體在村裡蓋了一所教會學校。
column5: mission 任務 + ary：帶著任務去傳播信仰

column2: The municipal library is run by the city government and is free to use.
column3: 市立圖書館由市政府營運，可免費使用。
column5: municipal 像「毛你死配」：市政事要配合

column2: The shy boy stayed mute during class, even when the teacher called his name.
column3: 那個害羞的男孩上課時一直不吭聲，連老師叫他的名字也不說話。
column5: mute 像「謬」：不說話，謬一個字都沒有

column2: The naval base keeps warships ready to protect the island's coast.
column3: 海軍基地隨時備妥軍艦，保護島嶼的海岸。
column5: naval 像「奈芙」：navy 海軍的形容詞

column2: The city was notorious for its heavy traffic and crowded streets.
column3: 這座城市因塞車嚴重、街道擁擠而惡名昭彰。
column5: not 知名 (note)：出名，但是壞名

column2: Calcium is a nutrient mineral that helps keep your bones strong.
column3: 鈣是一種有營養的礦物質，能幫助骨頭保持強壯。
column5: nutri 養分 + ent：給身體養分的

column2: Beans, fish, and vegetables make a nutritious dinner for growing children.
column3: 豆類、魚和蔬菜為成長中的孩子做成營養的晚餐。
column5: nutri 養分 + tious：滿滿養分的食物

column2: The factory is now operational and produces two hundred bikes a day.
column3: 工廠現在已經可以運作，每天生產兩百輛腳踏車。
column5: operate 運作 + ional：能夠開動的

column2: Wearing a school jacket is optional on warm days.
column3: 天氣暖和的日子，穿學校外套是自由選擇的。
column5: option 選擇 + al：可選可不選

column2: The students formed an orderly line and walked quietly into the hall.
column3: 學生們排成整齊的隊伍，安靜地走進大廳。
column5: order 秩序 + ly：井然有序

column2: It is outrageous that the tiny cup of tea costs one hundred dollars.
column3: 這小小一杯茶竟要一百元，真是離譜。
column5: out 超出 + rage 怒氣 → 太超過讓人氣憤

column2: The coach made an outright ban on phones during practice, with no exceptions.
column3: 教練全面禁止練習時使用手機，沒有任何例外。
column5: out 外 + right 對：一開口就直接了當

column2: The old dog looked so pathetic, soaked in rain, that we took him home.
column3: 那隻老狗淋了雨看起來好可憐，所以我們把牠帶回家。
column5: path 感受 (sympathy)：讓人心疼的

column2: Thousands of patriotic citizens sang the national anthem together at the stadium.
column3: 數千名愛國的公民在體育場一起唱國歌。
column5: patriot 愛國者 + ic：像愛國者一樣的

column2: She was persistent and called the shop five times until they fixed her bike.
column3: 她很有毅力，打了五次電話給店家，直到他們修好她的腳踏車。
column5: per 一直 + sist 站著 → 一直站著不走

column2: She has a photographic memory and remembers every page she has read.
column3: 她有過目不忘的好記憶，記得讀過的每一頁。
column5: photo 光 + graph 畫 → 用光畫下來的

column2: We stayed in a picturesque village with red roofs and a stone bridge.
column3: 我們住在一個有紅屋頂和石橋、美如圖畫的村莊。
column5: picture 圖畫 + esque 像 → 美得像畫

column2: Pollutant gases from cars can make the city air dirty.
column3: 汽車排出的污染性氣體會讓城市的空氣變髒。
column5: pollute 污染 + ant：造成髒空氣的

column2: The preliminary results show that the new method may work, but we need more tests.
column3: 初步結果顯示新方法可能有效，但我們需要更多測試。
column5: pre 之前 + limin 門檻 → 還在門檻前，還沒進門

column2: The baby was born premature, so the doctors kept her warm in a special bed.
column3: 那個寶寶是早產兒，所以醫生讓她待在特殊的保溫床裡。
column5: pre 之前 + mature 成熟 → 還沒成熟就來了

column2: Taipei is a premier travel spot, with the best food and the best museums.
column3: 台北是首屈一指的旅遊景點，有最棒的美食和最棒的博物館。
column5: premier 像「普里米耳」：排第一的主角
